entries.title: Ready lists name your GitHub sign-in once
entries.body: A computer's Ready to take over list, and the list before moving your first mate there, named your GitHub sign-in twice, with different advice each time. Each list now names it once: Ready to take over says the computer has no GitHub sign-in of its own and offers Sign in to GitHub there, and the move list says you sign in to GitHub again there.

picture.alt: Settings, Devices, with Mac mini's Ready to take over list naming GitHub once, on the line with its Sign in to GitHub there button
